display.purpose: The one display size per page (`display` utility): page titles and home chapter headings.

title.purpose: Display face at 1.875rem: calibre names in ledgers and the lab, mobile menu title, status plate statement.

title-sm.purpose: Display face at 1.5rem: selected part name and key figure in the lab.

body.purpose: Running prose at line-height 2; long reading at a 65ch measure.

body-sm.purpose: Panel prose, spec rows, button text, footer statement.

label.purpose: Persian section heads over a hairline, ledger column heads, nav links, chapter names. Never tracked.

caps.purpose: Latin-only tracked capitals: references, brand and model names, credits, indexes. Always dir=ltr.

wordmark.purpose: KRONOS in Bodoni Moda, tracked 0.45em, centred in header and footer.

shadows.name: object
shadows.purpose: Drop-shadow filter under cut-out movements resting in the page (--object-shadow).

shadows.name: object-contact
shadows.purpose: Ground shadow under the travelling movement, squashed as it turns (--object-contact).

shadows.name: rim-light
shadows.purpose: Softbox glow behind the object (rim-light utility); hero, finale, 404, status plate.

shadows.name: header-frost
shadows.purpose: The only translucent UI layer: the fixed header.

motion.name: ease-glide
motion.purpose: Default easing for every state and entrance transition (--ease-glide).

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Colour, border and arrow transitions on links, buttons and rows.

motion.name: duration-header
motion.purpose: Header hide/reveal (fade + 16px lift) and chapter bar colour.

motion.name: duration-chapter
motion.purpose: Film chapter text cross-fade with 24px rise and blur.

motion.name: cursor-spring
motion.purpose: Ring cursor lag behind the exact dot.

motion.name: float
motion.purpose: The travelling movement's slight drift, like an object hanging in a vitrine.

motion.name: depth-of-field
motion.purpose: Gallery plates sharpen as they reach the centre.

derivedRules.status: Derived from the built system for future surfaces; no article, figure or video template has shipped.
derivedRules.article: 65ch measure, 1rem at line-height 2, 85% foreground, 24px between paragraphs; section heads as a 0.75rem muted label over a hairline with 16px beneath; title in the page's one display size; counted steps in metal Persian ordinals.
derivedRules.figure: Square-cornered fixed-aspect plate, stone while loading, object-cover; figcaption on a hairline top rule with 12px padding; Persian caption at start in body, Latin credit or index at end in caps, muted, dir=ltr, tabular.
derivedRules.video: Same plate at 16:9; first frame or poster paints with the page; chapter markers as 1px bars (rule colour, metal when active) with label text; captions and credits as for figures; no autoplay or scrub under reduced motion.
derivedRules.typeOnMedia: Persian is never letter-spaced; tracked capitals only for Latin credits in caps.

narrative.overview:
Kronos is set like a museum case at night: one real movement hangs in soft rim light in the middle of a large, quiet room, and everything else on the page stays out of its way. The room is deep monochrome, ivory and stone by day and matte black and charcoal by night. Metal appears only where a watch house would engrave: a hairline, a small caption, an icon. There are no cards, no chips and no badges. Structure comes from 1px rules and from empty space.

The page is Persian and right to left. Persian display is set in Amiri, a classical Naskh with real thick and thin strokes, as the counterpart of the Latin didone, Bodoni Moda. Text is Vazirmatn for Persian and Jost for Latin. Latin names, references and credits are the only words that ever carry tracked capitals. Each page keeps one display size. Paragraphs are short and widely leaded, and long reading keeps a 65ch measure.

Motion is inertial and slow. Colour and state changes take 500ms on a long glide curve. The header slips away as you read and comes back when you scroll up. Gallery plates sharpen into focus as their neighbours blur, and a small ring cursor follows the pointer with spring lag and names what a drag or click will do. Every scroll effect has a still alternative when reduced motion is requested.
keyCharacteristics: Deep monochrome room in two themes; bronze (light) or pale gold (dark) metal only as line, small type and icon.
Square corners everywhere; 1px rules, metal-tinted for section heads and captions.
One filled control, the primary button, in ink on ivory (or ivory on black).
One display size per page; titles drop to the display face at 1.875rem or 1.5rem.
Depth comes from the object: drop shadows and rim light belong to the cut-out movement, never to UI surfaces.
Generous vertical rhythm (sections of 96 to 192px) inside an 80rem centred container.

rules.name: The Metal Is a Line Rule
rules.body: `--metal` draws lines, small type (0.875rem and below) and icons. It never fills a shape, sets a background or colours display type.

rules.name: The One Filled Control Rule
rules.body: Only the primary button is filled, in ink (or ivory at night). Every other control is text, an outline or a rule. The outline button fills only as its hover state.

rules.name: The Same Room Rule
rules.body: Any 3D stage's background is the page's own ivory or matte black, so the stage reads as the same room. Studio light colours inside the scene are physical materials and sit outside the token system.

rules.name: The One Display Size Rule
rules.body: A page has one display size, the `display` utility. A smaller heading is Title or Title Small in the same face, never a new step of the display clamp.

rules.name: The Untracked Persian Rule
rules.body: Persian is never letter-spaced, in any size or weight: tracking breaks the joins of the script. Tracked capitals are for Latin words only.

rules.name: The Counted Numerals Rule
rules.body: Figures that are indexes or measurements use tabular numerals; Persian ordinals in long reading are set at 0.75rem in the metal.

rules.name: The Object Casts the Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Soft offset shadows belong to cut-out physical objects. Interface elements stay flat and are separated by rules and space.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: No radius on any box, button, field, image or sheet. A circle is allowed only for a pointer or loading lens.

dos: Do use semantic tokens only (`background`, `foreground`, `surface`, `metal`, `border`); the 3D studio lights are the one physical exception.
Do keep each page to the one `display` size and cap headings by ch width (12ch to 22ch) instead of resizing them.
Do set long reading at a 65ch measure, line-height 2, with 24px between paragraphs, and head sections with a 0.75rem muted label over a hairline.
Do caption media on a hairline top rule: the Persian caption at the start, the Latin credit or index in `caps` with `dir="ltr"` at the end.
Do give a cut-out object the object shadow and a rim-light glow, and keep every other surface flat.
Do put `data-cursor` with a short Persian verb on any element where a drag or click does something unusual.
Do run transitions on `ease-glide` (500ms for colour, 700 to 1000ms for entrances) and provide a still version under reduced motion.
donts: Don't letter-space Persian text at any size; tracking breaks the joins.
Don't use `caps` or any tracking on Persian words; it is for Latin names, references and credits only.
Don't fill a control other than the primary button, or fill anything with the metal.
Don't round a corner on any box, button, image or field.
Don't put a box shadow on an interface surface; shadows belong to cut-out objects.
Don't build cards, chips, badges or kicker lines above headings; use ledger rows, hairline section heads and space.
Don't show a drawn model or illustration as a real calibre; a family without its CAD file gets the status plate.
